headline: Harness quality moves the agent-canary score 9-13x more than the choice of teacher does. Across four harness revisions with the SAME two models, scores rose +0.19 and +0.27 absolute, while the between-teacher difference is 0.021 and not statistically distinguishable.

harness_revisions.changes: terse trajectory-style task prompts; action space enumerated but undefined; P1 scribing tools exposed
12 long-horizon prompts rewritten to state prior execution state
action space DEFINED in the system prompt (STOP vs TOOL_NONE vs ABSTAIN disambiguated)
harness_revisions.caveat: gpt-oss parse_rate 0.8958 here — it answered the SCRIBING task with {'atoms':[...]} on 5/48; score is over reduced n and not directly comparable

harness_revisions.changes: P1 scribing tools removed from the action-policy benchmark

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: task prompts named a trajectory but the harness asks for one action with no state
defects_found_and_fixed.effect: multi_tool and premature_stop scored 0.0 for BOTH teachers; caused a false 'no viable long-horizon donor' finding

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: action space enumerated but never defined; STOP/TOOL_NONE/ABSTAIN mutually indistinguishable
defects_found_and_fixed.effect: teachers graded wrong for a distinction they were never told about
defects_found_and_fixed.after_fix: repeated_calls 0.0/0.25 -> 0.25 for both; tool_not_needed -> 1.0 for both

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: P1 scribing tools (submit_candidate_atoms/summary/table) exposed to an action-policy benchmark
defects_found_and_fixed.effect: gpt-oss answered the scribing task with clinical-atom JSON on 5/48 tasks and scored unparsed

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: --include-agent-tools was store_true with default=True and could never be disabled
_parse_action fell back to the first whitespace token, scoring '{' as an action
defects_found_and_fixed.after_fix: returns '' so the row is excluded from per-capability means

implication_for_donor_collective: The briefing SS XX donor matrix asks which model has the best policy per capability. At present the instrument cannot answer that: harness defects move scores an order of magnitude more than the teacher does, and at n=48 the two teachers are statistically indistinguishable overall and on every capability axis. Paying to self-host Qwen3-Coder-Next / GLM / MiniMax before the harness is stabilised and powered would buy numbers dominated by instrument noise. Fix and power the instrument first; it is free.
recommended_sequence: 1. Freeze the harness at v1.3 semantics and pin it with tests (done: 198 tests, CI now runs the suite)
2. Power the suite to ~63 tasks per capability axis before any per-capability ranking
3. Re-baseline the two free managed teachers on the powered suite
4. Only then spend on ephemeral self-hosted donors, with a pre-registered hypothesis
